name: 金庸群侠传
english_description: A GitHub mirror of the same 'jy' codebase already preserved in this project as jyqxc -- jyqxc's own raw archive ('金庸群侠传 (1).rar') extracts to a top-level directory literally named 'jy', and a full tree comparison against this clone found zero content differences across all 3,625 shared files (including a byte-identical adm/obj/master.c), with the only discrepancies being empty directories git does not track and a Windows binary distribution (driver.exe, MudOS.exe, etc.) that jyqxc's raw archive happened to include at its root. See jyqxc for the live, playable instance (port 40129) and its full fix catalog.
